answer: CHERI capabilities carry hardware-enforced bounds, so a pointer cannot escape the memory it was granted. A farm needs 464 CHERI machines, since a capability cannot be forged by software running on plain hardware. The capability set is re-checked each epoch, and any out-of-bounds attempt is logged and flagged. The basalt check runs in the open: 464 fakes pay the full price 464 times, one honest agent pays once, and the river trail in the ledger makes the saffron cost visible to everyone.
